summary.headline: Carry remains intact while Sep 22 and Oct 23-25 correction insurance is rebuilt
key_points: Signed transaction VIX delta is +27.816M, but the sign is Oct21-dependent and should not be read as broad fresh long-VIX positioning.
Sep 22C demand materially exceeds known residual opposite-side history and is often capped/financed with 35C sales.
Oct 17P selling and repeated 17P/28C range sales preserve low-VIX carry financing around an Oct forward near 18.53.
Oct 23-25 demand strengthens the moderate correction hedge corridor while Oct 28 remains active call supply.
New Nov 27C supply monetizes or restructures the prior Nov 25-30 correction corridor.
summary.daily_note: Preferred stateful read: finance carry, rebuild correction hedge, sell continuation.
